title: Would you survive a glacier calving right in front of your boat? #shorts
description: A wall of ice the size of a building breaks free and slams into the water beside you. #shorts #survival #didyouknow #scary
hook: What would happen if a glacier calved a huge chunk of ice right next to your boat?
script: You're drifting close to a glacier's edge for photos when a deep crack splits the ice face and a chunk the size of an apartment building breaks away, crashing into the fjord. The impact sends a wave rolling outward fast enough to flip the small boat that got too close. You're thrown into near-freezing meltwater, and cold shock seizes your breathing within the first minute. You don't survive.
captions: A deep crack splits the glacier's ice face.
A building-sized chunk breaks away.
It crashes into the fjord below.
The impact sends a wave rolling outward.
You don't survive.

title: Would you survive standing on an ice shelf as it starts to break apart? #shorts
description: The ice under your boots groans, then splits into a crack running straight toward you. #shorts #survival #didyouknow #scary
hook: What would happen if the ice shelf you were standing on suddenly started collapsing?
script: You're crossing a wide sheet of shelf ice when a low groan rises from underneath, and a crack races across the surface faster than you can outrun it. Instead of running upright, you drop flat and spread your weight, crawling toward thicker, whiter ice away from the fracture line. The section behind you tips into the water, but the ice under you holds. You survive.
captions: A low groan rises from beneath your feet.
A crack races faster than you can outrun.
You drop flat and spread your weight.
You crawl toward thicker ice.
The ice behind you tips, yours holds. You survive.

title: Would you survive a dust explosion inside a grain elevator? #shorts
description: A spark near the conveyor ignites the air itself, and the whole structure goes up in a chain reaction. #shorts #survival #didyouknow #scary
hook: What would happen if the grain dust in the elevator around you suddenly ignited?
script: Fine grain dust hangs thick in the air of the elevator, invisible enough that you barely notice it until a spark from a jammed conveyor belt sets it off. Unlike a normal fire, a dust explosion ignites the air itself in a fraction of a second, and the shockwave kicks up even more dust that ignites again in a chain reaction that can level an entire structure floor by floor. The blast wave reaches your level before you find the stairwell. You don't survive.
captions: Fine dust hangs invisible in the air.
A spark from the conveyor sets it off.
The explosion ignites the air itself.
Secondary blasts follow in seconds.
You don't survive.

title: Would you survive a flash flood inside a coal mine? #shorts
description: Water breaks through an old flooded tunnel and starts rising through the shaft fast. #shorts #survival #didyouknow #scary
hook: What would happen if water suddenly flooded the mine tunnel you were working in?
script: A drilling crew breaks through into an old abandoned tunnel that's been silently filling with groundwater for decades, and thousands of gallons come rushing through the breach at once. The water rises through the lower shaft fast, cutting off the main exit route within minutes. You move immediately toward the higher tunnels instead of the flooding exit, reach a sealed refuge chamber stocked with air, and wait as rescue crews drill through from the surface. You survive.
captions: Water breaks through into an old flooded tunnel.
Thousands of gallons rush in at once.
The shaft's lower levels flood within minutes.
You move to the higher tunnels instead.
Rescue crews drill through. You survive.
